title: Preview
description: Request: the selected file's details and a thumbnail for the Preview Panel. Sent only on selection, for a file (never a folder). Its own channel, latest wins: a newer preview ends a running one with cancelled, so holding an arrow key never queues previews. The file is only read, never written, opened only when its type has a thumbnail to read, and never opened at all when it is stored only online. The reply is previewReady; a file that can't be read is a previewReady with an outcomeCode, never an error.

path.description: The file's full path: a listed folder's path joined with its name, or a name match's path. Normalized by the engine as showInFolder's path is.
